description: Festivals, fireworks, illuminations, seasonal events and similar in Japan whose dates were confirmed on official announcements. Filter by date range, region and kind. Each event has its dates, venue, nearest place ID and the official URL. Returns from, to, total, events[]: id, name, kind, start, end, time, venue, region, nearestPlace (id usable as a find_routes destination), description, caution, officialUrl, fee (free, paid or part), dateSource (official or press), routesPage; and page (the event list on the site).

from.description: First day (Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days after from. The range may span at most 366 days.

name: find_events
title: Find events and festivals
